公元前 7000—1900 年 · c. 7000—1900 BCE

在土与玉之间，
重访文明的清晨Revisiting the dawn
of complex societies

从黄河中游的早期村落，到长江下游的城址与水利系统：以六种考古学文化为线索，观察生产、聚落、工艺与礼仪如何共同变化。

Follow six archaeological cultures—from early villages in the central Yellow River basin to the walled centre and hydraulic works of the lower Yangtze—and trace changes in subsistence, settlement, craft and ritual.

02 / CULTURES

六种文化，六条线索Six cultures, six lines of inquiry

以河南中部为核心的黄河中游地区Middle Yellow River region, centred in Henan

中原地区早期新石器文化群之一，显示定居程度提高、低水平食物生产与广谱采集渔猎并行。One of the early Neolithic cultural complexes of the Central Plains, combining increasingly settled life and low-level food production with broad-spectrum foraging and fishing.

太行山东麓、河北南部一带Eastern foothills of the Taihang Mountains, southern Hebei

华北早期新石器文化之一，以磁山遗址的储藏坑、石磨盘磨棒和陶盂支架组合著称。An early Neolithic culture of North China, noted at Cishan for storage pits, grinding equipment, and bowl-and-support pottery sets.

黄河中游，以河南、陕西、山西为核心Middle Yellow River, especially Henan, Shaanxi and Shanxi

分布广、延续久且内部类型丰富的文化复合体；彩陶虽醒目，却不是其全部面貌。A widespread, long-lived and internally diverse cultural complex; painted pottery is prominent but does not define its entire character.

生业Subsistence

粟作农业、家畜饲养、采集与渔猎共同构成生业。Millet cultivation, animal husbandry, gathering, fishing and hunting formed a mixed subsistence base.

农业Agriculture

旱作以粟、黍为主，不同区域和阶段的作物组合有所变化。Dry farming focused on foxtail and broomcorn millet, with regional and chronological variation.

陶器与物质文化Material culture

红陶和彩陶常见，鱼、鸟、植物与几何纹样经过抽象化处理；晚期出现更多灰黑陶。Red and painted wares are common, with abstracted fish, bird, plant and geometric motifs; grey and black wares became more frequent in later phases.

聚落Settlement

从半坡等村落到晚期大型中心，聚落规模与布局差异显著。Settlements range from villages such as Banpo to large late centres, with substantial variation in scale and layout.

墓葬Burial

公共墓地与多样葬俗并存；随葬差异随区域和时期变化。Communal cemeteries and diverse mortuary practices coexisted; grave-good differences vary by region and period.

社会Society

晚期部分大型中心呈现分工和社会复杂化，但仰韶文化内部并非同质。Some large late centres show specialization and increasing complexity, but Yangshao communities were not socially uniform.

礼仪Ritual

彩陶图像、特殊器物与部分聚落空间可能涉及礼仪，解释需结合具体语境。Painted imagery, special vessels and some settlement spaces may have carried ritual roles, which must be evaluated contextually.

文化关系Relationships

与北方红山、西北马家窑及中原后续文化长期互动。It interacted over long periods with Hongshan to the north, Majiayao to the northwest and later Central Plains traditions.

历史意义Significance

其发现确立了中国新石器时代研究的重要框架，并持续影响对农业、聚落与文化互动的理解。Its discovery established a major framework for Chinese Neolithic studies and continues to shape research on farming, settlement and cultural interaction.

代表遗址

仰韶村遗址Yangshao Village site

河南渑池Mianchi, Henan

发现地与命名地，也是中国现代考古学史上的标志性遗址。The discovery and type-site, and a landmark in the history of modern Chinese archaeology.

半坡遗址Banpo site

陕西西安Xi'an, Shaanxi

中期仰韶村落的代表性遗址。A major example of a Middle Yangshao village.

University of Cambridge, Department of Archaeology仰韶村国家考古遗址公园

西辽河流域，内蒙古东南与辽宁西部West Liao River basin, southeastern Inner Mongolia and western Liaoning

东北地区重要新石器文化，以玉器传统和牛河梁大型仪式中心著称。A major Neolithic culture of Northeast China, known for jade traditions and the monumental ritual centre at Niuheliang.

长江下游环太湖地区Circum-Taihu region of the lower Yangtze

以稻作农业为基础，形成具有城址、水利系统、等级墓地与统一玉器信仰体系的区域中心。Supported by rice cultivation, Liangzhu developed a regional centre with a walled city, hydraulic works, ranked cemeteries and a shared jade-based belief system.

广义见于黄河中下游；此处重点介绍山东龙山Broadly across the middle and lower Yellow River; this site focuses on Shandong Longshan

“龙山”可作广义晚期新石器文化标签；山东龙山以快轮黑陶、城址和更明显的社会分化著称。“Longshan” can be a broad label for several Late Neolithic traditions; Shandong Longshan is especially known for fast-wheel black pottery, walled settlements and sharper social differentiation.

05 / COMPARE

六种文化的多维对照A multidimensional comparison

字段仰韶文化Yangshao Culture良渚文化Liangzhu Culture龙山文化Longshan Culture
年代Period约公元前5000—3000年c. 5000–3000 BCE约公元前3300—2300年c. 3300–2300 BCE约公元前3000—1900年；山东龙山常约前2600—2000年c. 3000–1900 BCE; Shandong Longshan often c. 2600–2000 BCE
区域Region黄河中游，以河南、陕西、山西为核心Middle Yellow River, especially Henan, Shaanxi and Shanxi长江下游环太湖地区Circum-Taihu region of the lower Yangtze广义见于黄河中下游；此处重点介绍山东龙山Broadly across the middle and lower Yellow River; this site focuses on Shandong Longshan
农业Agriculture旱作以粟、黍为主，不同区域和阶段的作物组合有所变化。Dry farming focused on foxtail and broomcorn millet, with regional and chronological variation.稻作生产支撑大型聚落与公共工程；具体组织方式仍依赖持续研究。Rice production supported large settlements and public works; its exact organization remains under investigation.黄河下游旱作农业持续发展，区域内作物组合有所差异。Dry farming continued to develop in the lower Yellow River, with regional variation in crop assemblages.
生业Subsistence粟作农业、家畜饲养、采集与渔猎共同构成生业。Millet cultivation, animal husbandry, gathering, fishing and hunting formed a mixed subsistence base.稻作农业构成经济基础，同时利用水生与陆生资源。Rice farming formed the economic base alongside aquatic and terrestrial resources.以农业为主，并结合畜养、狩猎与采集。Agriculture was central, supplemented by animal husbandry, hunting and gathering.
物质文化Material culture红陶和彩陶常见，鱼、鸟、植物与几何纹样经过抽象化处理；晚期出现更多灰黑陶。Red and painted wares are common, with abstracted fish, bird, plant and geometric motifs; grey and black wares became more frequent in later phases.灰黑陶、刻划纹陶器与精细器物并见。Grey and black wares, incised decoration and finely made vessels are present.快轮制作的磨光黑陶最具代表性，蛋壳黑陶体现高度专业化工艺。Fast-wheel, burnished black ware is diagnostic; eggshell pottery demonstrates highly specialized craftsmanship.
聚落Settlement从半坡等村落到晚期大型中心，聚落规模与布局差异显著。Settlements range from villages such as Banpo to large late centres, with substantial variation in scale and layout.良渚古城具有宫殿区、内外城与外围水利系统，周边存在等级化聚落网络。Liangzhu City contained a palatial zone, inner and outer city, and an extensive peripheral hydraulic system within a ranked settlement network.城子崖等遗址发现城墙；大型聚落内出现居住、手工业与仪式空间分区。Walls are known at sites such as Chengziya; large settlements show zoning of residence, craft and ritual activity.
墓葬Burial公共墓地与多样葬俗并存；随葬差异随区域和时期变化。Communal cemeteries and diverse mortuary practices coexisted; grave-good differences vary by region and period.墓地随葬品数量与类型差异显著，反映清晰的社会等级。Marked differences in the quantity and types of grave goods reveal a pronounced social hierarchy.墓葬规模和随葬品差异扩大，精细黑陶常与高等级墓葬相关。Differences in tomb size and grave goods widened, with fine black pottery often associated with higher-status burials.
社会复杂化Social complexity晚期部分大型中心呈现分工和社会复杂化，但仰韶文化内部并非同质。Some large late centres show specialization and increasing complexity, but Yangshao communities were not socially uniform.UNESCO将古城遗址概括为具有社会分化与统一信仰体系的早期区域性国家。UNESCO describes the site as an early regional state with social differentiation and a unified belief system.专业手工业、聚落等级和墓葬差异共同显示复杂化加深。Specialized production, settlement hierarchy and mortuary differentiation indicate intensifying complexity.

本表只呈现有来源支持的差异，不以单一“先进程度”排序。
